decisions.decision: Preserve the existing Discord experience while allowing substantial replacement of Ebi internals.
decisions.reason: Drew accepts internal replacement but does not accept a worse or more complicated Discord workflow.

decisions.decision: Keep the runtime backend-neutral with Codex and Claude Code as peer adapters.
decisions.reason: Drew expects a friend to add Claude Code and wants future harnesses to remain possible.

decisions.decision: Use external harness projects as design references, not additional live orchestrators.
decisions.reason: Drew wants an effective, token-conscious system without unused or overlapping machinery.

decisions.decision: Diagnostics and cleanup remain on demand.
decisions.reason: Drew explicitly does not want a harness review or monitor continuously running.
